name: B10-0194/2025 (ECR) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking Thailand to change a law that punishes criticism of the monarchy with up to 15 years in prison. It wants the law amended to meet international standards and political prisoners released. It also criticises Thailand for sending at least 40 Uyghur detainees back to China, where they may face serious human rights abuses, and urges China to protect their rights.

- Thailand is asked to amend Article 112 and release people jailed for expression.
- Thailand is criticised for deporting 40 Uyghurs to China; China is urged to protect them.
- The resolution is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.
